title: The Empty Boat
summary: Test other meanings of key words.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A boat is filled with people, yet there is not a single person on board.
points: A boat is filled with people, yet there is not a single person on board.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The puzzle plays with a word.
Which word could mean something other than the obvious?
points: The puzzle plays with a word.

steps.title: The method: Look for double meanings
sentences: The phrase 'single person' can mean 'not married'.
So the boat could be full of people who are married.
The puzzle uses 'single' in a different way from what you first imagine.
points: The phrase 'single person' can mean 'not married'.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Everyone on board is married, so there is not a single, that is unmarried, person.
The puzzle works because of a word with two meanings.
Read each word for more than one meaning.
points: Everyone on board is married, so there is not a single, that is unmarried, person.

quiz.q: In the boat riddle, what does single mean?
